title: PNP personnel, ex-soldier arrested in Pangasinan firearms buy-bust

blocks.text: An active police personnel and a former Army serviceman were arrested for the alleged illegal sale of firearms and ammunition during a buy-bust operation in Villasis, Pangasinan, on Tuesday, October 13, the Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) said.
